_comment: ThreePlayerTicTacToe locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is.

_slots.{symbol}: The player's mark, one of A, B or C
_slots.{row}: The board row index of the placed mark
_slots.{col}: The board column index of the placed mark
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII board (do not translate)
_slots.{moves}: The comma-separated list of available move tokens like '[4]' (do not translate)

player_prompt.intro:
Ko koe te Kaiwhaiwha {player_id} i te Tic Tac Toe o te Tokotoru.
Ko tohu ko '{symbol}'.
Ka rite koe ki te whakapai i to tohu ki runga i te papa 5x5 ki te hanga i te rerenga o te wha.
Ka taea e nga rerenga te whai i te ahau, te tuarongo, me te taha-kore.
Tukua to neke i te ahua '[4]' ki te tohu i te cell 4.

invalid_move.wrong_format: He hōputu nekehanga hē. Whakamahia te "[cell]" kei reira he pūtau 0-{max_cell} .
invalid_move.out_of_range: Tau cell heke: {cell}. Me noho i waenganui o 0 me {max_cell}.
invalid_move.made_invalid: Kua mahia e te kaitākaro {player_id} he nekehanga kore.

game_action.placed: Kaiwhaiwha {player_id} ka whakapai i tohu ({symbol}) ki te mara ({row}, {col}).
